page_title: UNI 0-2 HOF | Union Berlin v Hoffenheim 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
90+2' The manager makes a subsitution with Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) coming on for Pavel Kaderabek.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Union Berlin.
89' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) picked up a yellow card from referee.
87' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
87' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.

86' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
85' Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
85' The attendance is 20000.
85' A cross from a corner kick by Union Berlin is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
83' Union Berlin take a short corner kick.
82' Hoffenheim fail to score from a corner as Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) leaps to collect the ball.
80' Substitution. Leonardo Bonucci makes his way off the pitch and Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) comes on as his replacement.
80' Here is a change. Robin Gosens is going off and Urs Fischer gives the last tactical orders to Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
78' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall.
78' Hoffenheim win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
76' It will be a substitution. Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Lucas Tousart walks off.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) replaces Robert Skov.
74' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Andrej Kramaric and he is replaced by Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).
72' The foul by Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Deniz Aytekin.
70' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
70' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Here comes a substitution. Sheraldo Becker is given a rest as he is replaced by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin).
68' Union Berlin take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
68' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Corner kick. Union Berlin will have an opportunity.
66' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
66' The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
63' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Oliver Baumann easily deals with the threat.
62' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
60' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

59' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Hoffenheim win a corner.
58' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
55' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) replacing Maximilian Beier.
55' Substitution. Wout Weghorst will be replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
54' The game is interrupted. Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
51' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Urs Fischer gives a chance to David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) and Brenden Aaronson is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
44' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Hoffenheim are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
42' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Deniz Aytekin changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
42' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Hoffenheim, he's going to review using VAR.

41' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Hoffenheim!
38' 0 - 2 Goal! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
36' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
34' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
34' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Hoffenheim.
30' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
29' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' The game is interrupted now, Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' 0 - 1 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Frederik Ronnow.
22' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
22' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
21' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Hoffenheim as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
21' Leonardo Bonucci (Union Berlin) was too forceful with his tackle and Deniz Aytekin interrupted the game to signal a free kick. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Hoffenheim.
19' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
18' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
17' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
15' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow is equal to it and makes an easy save.
14' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
9' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
8' A player from Union Berlin commits a rough challenge. Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Hoffenheim earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
7' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
6' The ball falls kindly for Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
